block.name: Burst Time Tagger CC
block.doc:
This block adds UHD-compatible time tags to a complex stream, generating one or more bursts inside a repeated pattern.
TIME MODEL:
- "Active period (s)" (period_s): duration of the region where bursts are allowed (e.g. a 5G-like frame of 10 ms).
- "Gap after period (s)" (gap_s): optional silent region after the active part, where no bursts are scheduled. This is useful when doing spectrum sensing between frames.
- Effective repetition period is: T_effective = period_s + gap_s
For each integer k = 0, 1, 2, ... (period index) and each offset o in "Offsets (s)", a burst is scheduled at:
t_burst = t0_usrp + k * T_effective + o + lead_s
with "Burst length (samples)" samples.
"Sample rate (Hz)" is used to convert sample indices into UHD time.
SPECIAL CASE: If "Offsets (s)" is an empty list, the block behaves as if it were [0.0] (one burst per active period, starting at the beginning).
CONTROL PORT "ctrl" (MOD):
The message port "ctrl" expects a PMT dict with optional keys:
- "t0_usrp": double, absolute UHD time in seconds. When present, it overrides the internal t0_usrp. - "lead_s" : double, additional lead time in seconds applied to all bursts.
This is typically driven by a timing/control block (e.g. slot_guard_cc) which knows the real USRP vs host offset and can select a safe starting time for the bursts.
PARAMETERS: - Sample rate (Hz): real USRP sampling rate. - Active period (s): length of the active region where bursts live. - Gap after period (s): silent time after the active region. - Burst length (samples): number of samples in each burst. - Initial USRP time (s): absolute UHD time of global sample index 0. - Offsets (s): Python list of offsets inside each active period, in seconds (e.g. [0.0, 0.001, 0.005]). - Lead ahead (s): extra lead added to the burst time. Can be kept at 0.0 if a control block is already pushing t0_usrp far enough into the future.
CALLBACKS: - set_samp_rate(samp_rate) - set_period(period_s) - set_gap(gap_s) - set_burst_len(burst_len) - set_t0_usrp(t0_usrp) - set_offsets(offsets_s) - set_lead(lead_s)
